set.body: Goal: implement the deterministic, fail-closed EyeLink validation-artifact generator independently of licensed vendor evidence, so the later vendor run only supplies certified inputs. Acceptance criteria: the generator writes validation/eyes4s-eyelink-validation-<version>.json; binds source revision and dirty state, schema and support matrix, corpus/oracle/converter identities and options, JVM/Scala.js evidence, differential metrics, mutation receipts, performance evidence, warnings, and unsupported cells; release mode refuses dirty or mismatched inputs while development mode is visibly non-release; a drift suite detects stale or hand-edited artifacts; public aggregate output exposes no private gaze content. Closing this bead proves generator behavior only and does not claim EDF API, EDF2ASC, or real-EDF conformance.
set.title: Build deterministic EyeLink validation artifact generator
